meta.name: add-matrix
meta.description: Add Matrix channel integration via Chat SDK. Works with any Matrix homeserver.

copy.tagline: 集成 Matrix 聊天频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Matrix 聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Matrix chat channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Matrix chat to your application

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 Matrix 聊天通道加到项目里：复制适配器、注册通道、安装依赖、修补代码、运行构建测试，并带你设置一个专用的 Matrix 机器人账号和凭据。
howto.when: 当你说要接入 Matrix 通道、添加 Matrix 适配器，或是在 /setup 流程中出现相关步骤时触发。

say.text: 帮我接入 Matrix 通道
say.note: Claude 会开始执行添加 Matrix 通道的步骤。

say.text: 添加 Matrix 适配器到项目
say.note: 触发复制和注册适配器的操作。

say.text: 配置 Matrix 机器人账号
say.note: Claude 会引导你创建机器人账号并填写凭据。

howto.what_en: Adds Matrix channel support: copies adapter, registers channel, installs pinned dependency, patches imports, builds/tests, and guides bot account setup.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a Matrix channel, add the Matrix adapter, or during /setup flow steps related to Matrix.

say_en.text: Add a Matrix channel for me.
say_en.note: Claude starts the Matrix channel setup.

say_en.text: Add the Matrix adapter to the project.
Set up the Matrix bot credentials.
say_en.note: Claude guides bot account and credential setup.
